Frameworks & Libraries.definition: Application frameworks/libraries; legacy runtime/engine exceptions documented per item.

Databases & Caching.definition: Database/cache engines and directly related data-system classes; excludes brokers, processing tools and general data practices.

Cloud & DevOps.definition: Cloud platforms/services, infrastructure/OS and operational tooling; delivery practices are crosswalked to methodologies.

Tools, Architecture & Protocols.definition: Named engineering/design/productivity tools and legacy architecture/protocol/notation bucket; method practices crosswalk to methodologies.

Methodologies & Soft Skills.definition: Two distinct types: hard methods/practices and behavioral soft skills; group never determines skill_type.

unassigned_policy: null is a metadata gap, not a seventh group or exclusion of a valid hard skill
legacy_limit: Task soft-skill label and legacy methodologies bucket differ; hard methods are explicitly typed hard. Technical knowledge with no clean task bucket stays null.
